title: Test that the session pane anchors the session action notice to the active session in session view
outcome: A SessionPaneView-level or App-level test reports a session action notice for the active session. It asserts that the alert renders inside that session's pane, between the activity strip and the composer or delegated-child footer, in session view. It also asserts that the alert does not render in a pane showing another session, or in a non-session view mode.
acceptance: Test that the session pane anchors the session action notice to the active session in session view is done
